changes.title: Shared guest rooms
items: Both guest bedrooms open during a visit, with shared wardrobes, dressing tables and beds.

changes.title: Paused means still
items: Pausing keeps the last world picture behind the menu. Guidance pointers, invitation flashes and creature bubbles hold their place until play resumes.

changes.title: Visit failure
items: The telephone explains when a visit cannot start.
Starting a new visit ignores late confirmations from an earlier call.
